rationale: Final result after the fix-up round. The review of the redesigned change raised one major finding (CR-001, missing test for the backfill pager query). It was fixed in 142aae80e (test of the real paging query plus a cursor guard) and the user approved the fix-up at gate code-review.final on 2026-10-22 (see decisions.jsonl). The first-round result of the superseded design is kept in review-v1/code-review-round1.json.

standards_review.notes: All 7 subjects in the review range match the documented EPMCDME-####: Description format
